scope: Canonical authored Markdown documents and memory documents. Field review only; no code or source-record changes.

authorities.role: Configured docs surface, architecture locations and specialized surfaces
Document genre vocabulary and deprecated aliases; vocabulary is not an exhaustive record schema
Diagram type vocabulary and conditional related_code/related_surfaces/related_agents requirements
memory-project, memory-reference and memory-user destination conventions; these are Document subtypes, not separately structured stores
Required fields, statuses and flight levels
Selected required-field/value checks; permits additional frontmatter keys
All docs Markdown requires nonempty description at authoring time
Architecture authoring contract including parent, children and diagram_type
Path entries permit strings or single-key label-to-path mappings
Generated Agent cards are duplicate renderings; excludes docs/agents/cards

discovery.path_safety: Resolve configured roots relative to the supplied immutable source root and refuse escapes. Do not follow files outside the source root.
include: Authored architecture, how-to, reference, explanation, tutorial, retrospective and miscellaneous docs, including folder README and guide files
docs/architecture/components/*.md as Documents: these files are separate authored artifacts from docs/components.json Component registry records
Authored docs/agents guides such as docs/agents/documentation/reference-author.md; these are not generated Agent cards
docs/known-issues/**/*.md including issue pages, component aggregate pages and README
Authored Markdown under acceptance-criteria or product-truth directories, including guides; the structured YAML/JSON artifact readers do not own these Markdown records
memory/*.md whether or not frontmatter exists

exclude.reason: Exact specialized canonical ADR files; retain ordinary ADR folder guides as Documents
One canonical source yields term records; avoid duplicate document record

exclude.pattern: configured roadmap source with suffix changed from .json to .md
exclude.reason: Generated roadmap mirror; checked docs/roadmap.md explicitly identifies docs/roadmap.json as source
Legacy changelog source family has its own reader

exclude.pattern: Canonical product-truth artifact generated Markdown views, when present
exclude.reason: Use manifest ownership or an unambiguous generated-view marker tied to a canonical source; do not exclude arbitrary docs mentioning generated content or files with flow in their names

discovery.out_of_root_families: tickets/, changelogs/, templates/agents/, templates/skills/, config/* registries and source/test files are outside this discovery root. Do not add a whole-repository Markdown glob.
discovery.component_document_resolution: The earlier inventory phrase excluding component specializations needs this refinement: Component registry metadata belongs to Component; component Markdown belongs to Document. Do not project registry metadata twice, delete old Component hubs, or substitute a hyphenated document stem for registry ID.
discovery.generated_subsections: An authored document containing generated subsections remains a Document. docs/agents/README.md is an example. Avoid broad generated-word filtering.

identity.native_id: Repository-relative POSIX document path including filename extension; not filename stem, title or optional id
identity.canonical_id: Document:<native_id> for newly added nodes, as allocated by shared integration
identity.reason: Document titles and filenames repeat across folders and native frontmatter id is not universally defined. Path identity is deterministic and preserves separate artifacts.
identity.locator: Empty string for the whole document record
identity.native_id_fields: If a document authors id, preserve it verbatim in metadata; never silently substitute it for path identity.
identity.provenance: Read exact immutable Git revision, retain source_path/source_sha/content_hash supplied by integration. A same-path SourceFile reference may coexist; that is not a second Document.

source_fields.storage_rule: Copy the entire parsed YAML frontmatter mapping without a whitelist, schema defaulting, enum normalization or inferred values. Preserve unknown extension keys, native scalar types, nulls, empty containers and nested values.
source_fields.why_extraction_has_no_required_frontmatt: 41 selected real files lack frontmatter; memory is commonly prose-only and older documents predate the current enforcement. Missing authored metadata must stay missing. Reader parse errors must fail explicitly, but it must not reject legacy documents solely because modern authoring rules would require more fields.

field_contracts.title: Human-readable source title, string
field_contracts.type: Source document genre string; preserve legacy aliases and observed noncurrent values verbatim
field_contracts.status: Documentation lifecycle, normally active/draft/deprecated/migrating; distinct from an issue's prose status
field_contracts.created: Authored YAML date or quoted string; preserve type
field_contracts.last_updated: Authored YAML date or quoted string; preserve type
field_contracts.description: Native short document summary; do not replace with full Markdown body
field_contracts.components: List of explicitly authored component IDs; no inferred directory ownership
field_contracts.diagram_type: Enum from config/diagram_types.json; preserve deprecated dataflow alias
field_contracts.parent: String path or explicit null for diagram root
field_contracts.children: List of child diagram paths; preserve []
field_contracts.related_docs: List of path strings or single-key label-to-path mappings; preserve labels and order
field_contracts.related_code: List of path strings or single-key label-to-path mappings
field_contracts.architecture_diagrams: Optional path-bearing list accepted by validator, even though not observed in selected files
field_contracts.related_surfaces: Optional architecture list, conditionally required for user_flow
field_contracts.related_agents: Agent reference list, conditionally required for agent_flow
field_contracts.category: Observed classification string, often reference; do not overwrite type
field_contracts.source_ticket: Observed source ticket string or explicit null
field_contracts.date: Observed retrospective date, native date or quoted string
field_contracts.stack: UI context mapping with framework/css strings; preserve future keys
field_contracts.stylesheets: UI context source stylesheet path list
field_contracts.fonts: UI context fonts source pointer string
field_contracts.data_layer: UI context structured mapping; nested shape documented below

source_fields.subtype_policy: Keep authored type unchanged. Derived document_family can identify known_issue/memory/component_document by canonical path. Do not rewrite reference to known_issue or invent memory frontmatter.

nested_shapes.shape: array<string | object with exactly one label:string-path entry>
nested_shapes.preserve: Label text, source path, list index/order and null/empty distinction; mapping entries must not collapse to bare paths

nested_shapes.shape: object: framework:string, css:string; open for future keys
object: data_access_seam:string, loaders_convention:string, fixtures_dir:string, fixtures_formats:array<string>, mock_toggle:object, drift_guard:string
object: env_default:string, badge_flag:string, runtime_override:string, production_lock:string, resolution_order:string
Safe YAML maps/lists/scalars; preserve structure recursively, without promoting embedded illustrative domain examples to separate graph records

derived_fields.body: Exact Markdown body after closing whole-line frontmatter delimiter, or whole file when frontmatter absent; expose separately from authored frontmatter
derived_fields.document_family: Optional explicitly derived path family: memory, known_issue, component_document, or ordinary document
derived_fields.display_title: Native title if a nonempty string, otherwise first H1 outside frontmatter, otherwise filename stem; fallback belongs to display/derived data, never inserted into source metadata
derived_fields.display_description: Native description if a string, otherwise empty; do not fabricate a prose summary
derived_fields.body_parse_policy: Do not parse arbitrary headings/prose into purported universal metadata. Known-issue status/severity in prose differ from documentation lifecycle and filename severity buckets; preserve body without claiming a structured issue schema.

observations.count_basis: Working-tree bounded metadata census on 2026-10-02, not an immutable Aura count or full schema validation. No generated product-truth Markdown views currently exist under docs/product-truth; only two authored README files.

coder_acceptance_checks: Full frontmatter exact equality after generic Neo4j property encode/decode, including nested UI context, labeled path entries, reserved id/title/current source keys, booleans, integer and quoted/native dates
No-frontmatter memory preserves empty metadata and exact body; missing description remains missing
Explicit null source_ticket, empty components/children and absent keys remain distinct
Configured docs/adrs/glossary/roadmap roots are honored and external path escapes rejected
Same filename in two folders yields different Document native IDs
ADR files, Agent cards, glossary, roadmap mirror and legacy changelogs excluded while authored Agent reference docs, component docs and guides remain included
Known-issue frontmatter status remains active even when body says open; no inferred issue lifecycle overwrites it
Malformed frontmatter fails explicitly; delimiter-like substrings in strings do not terminate frontmatter
Reader does not execute content, resolve links outside immutable root, or manufacture schema defaults
